_comment: Generated by scripts/build-model-guidance.mjs. Derived from the risk tier, length and image use of each skill; not measured. Edit data/model-guidance-overrides.json, not this file.

high-stakes.why: High-stakes tier: a wrong figure or a missed clause costs the reader money or a legal position.

consequential.why: Consequential tier: the output is acted on, so spend effort on the checks rather than on a larger model.

long.why: Long method: many rules to hold at once.

vision.why: Reads images: the smallest model loses detail on dense screenshots and charts.

short.why: Informational tier and a short, bounded method: the smallest model follows it, at a twentieth of the price.

base.why: Informational tier: the default model at its normal effort.

chart-data-extractor.why: Reads values off chart pixels; the skill's own requirements section asks for the strongest vision model available.

docx-tracked-changes.why: Edits a contract-style document change by change; a dropped change is hard to see afterwards.

pptx-slide-auditor.why: Audits rendered slides as images; small text and alignment need the stronger vision model.
